closing_cost.page_subtitle: Know your additional costs before you make the final decision to buy!
closing_cost.transaction_price_helper: Enter the agreed purchase price to calculate percentage-based fees.
closing_cost.transaction_price_disclaimer: Enter the property price in MXN. USD estimates appear in parentheses using the exchange rate below.
closing_cost.exchange_rate_helper: Used to show USD reference values. Adjust to match the current market rate.
closing_cost.exchange_rate_fetch_error: We could not fetch the latest rate. Please try again or enter it manually.
closing_cost.fideicomiso_prompt_title: Are you a non-Mexican citizen purchasing in a restricted zone (coastal/border)?
closing_cost.fideicomiso_prompt_helper: If yes, bank trust (fideicomiso) setup and a foreign affairs permit are required and will be added to the calculation.
closing_cost.disclaimer: Actual closing costs vary by municipality, currency, and service providers. Consult your local advisor before committing to a transaction.

isai.label: Property Acquisition Tax (ISAI)
isai.note: A state-level transfer tax. The percentage varies by state and municipality.

notaryFees.label: Notary Fees
notaryFees.note: Covers the government-appointed notary who certifies the transaction.

registrationFees.label: Property Registration Fees
registrationFees.note: Official registration in the Public Registry.

fideicomisoSetup.label: Fideicomiso (Bank Trust) Setup
fideicomisoSetup.note: Required one-time setup for foreign buyers in restricted zones.

foreignAffairsPermit.label: Foreign Affairs Ministry Permit
foreignAffairsPermit.note: Permit from the Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores for foreign buyers.

legalFees.label: Legal / Attorney Services
legalFees.note: Due diligence, contract review, and transaction oversight.

iva.label: IVA (Value Added Tax)
iva.note: Often applied to notary and legal service fees.

appraisalFees.label: Appraisal Fees
appraisalFees.note: Assessment of the property value for tax and due diligence.

titleInsurance.label: Title Insurance
titleInsurance.note: Protection against title disputes. Optional depending on risk tolerance.

escrowFees.label: Escrow Fees
escrowFees.note: Neutral third party to hold funds during the transaction.

ownership_cost.page_subtitle: Estimate annual holding costs across taxes, maintenance, and professional services.
ownership_cost.property_value_helper: Used to estimate annual predial taxes. Enter the assessed value in MXN.
ownership_cost.rental_income_helper: Used for property management fee estimates. Enter zero if the property is not rented.
ownership_cost.fideicomiso_prompt_title: Are you a foreign owner with property in a restricted zone (coastal/border)?
ownership_cost.fideicomiso_prompt_helper: If yes, the annual fideicomiso fee is required and included below.
ownership_cost.disclaimer: Actual costs vary by municipality, property type, and service level. Consult local professionals for precise budgeting.

propertyTaxes.label: Property Taxes (Predial)
propertyTaxes.helper: Typical annual rate: 0.1% - 0.15% of cadastral value
propertyTaxes.note: Paid annually based on government-assessed value. Discounts often available for early payment.

hoaFees.label: Homeowners Association (HOA) Fees
hoaFees.note: Mandatory for condos/gated communities; covers shared amenities, security, and maintenance.

fideicomisoAnnual.label: Fideicomiso (Bank Trust) Fee
fideicomisoAnnual.note: Required for foreign owners in restricted zones (coasts/borders). Paid to the trustee bank.

insurance.label: Insurance
insurance.note: Recommended for natural disaster coverage (hurricanes, earthquakes) and theft.

propertyManagement.label: Property Management Fees
propertyManagement.note: Applied if renting the property out and using a third-party management service.

seller_cost.page_subtitle: Estimate capital gains tax and transaction fees when you sell property in Mexico.
seller_cost.sale_price_helper: Enter the agreed sale price. All calculations are in MXN.
seller_cost.residency_helper: Capital gains treatment differs for residents (with RFC) and non-residents.
seller_cost.cost_basis_helper: Include original purchase price, capital improvements with facturas, and allowable selling expenses.
seller_cost.primary_residence_helper: Apply exemption (up to ~700,000 UDIs) if you qualify—must be primary residence, RFC, CURP, and no exemption claimed in the past 3 years.
seller_cost.capital_gains_helper: Typical effective rates range from 10% to 35% of the taxable gain depending on documentation and personal tax situation.
seller_cost.capital_gains_resident_hint: Residents apply progressive ISR rates (10%-35%) after exemptions and deductions.
seller_cost.capital_gains_nonresident_hint: A 35% flat rate tax on net gain applies to Non-residents.
seller_cost.agent_commission_helper: Typical commission is 5% - 8% of the sale price plus 16% VAT.
seller_cost.fideicomiso_helper: Banks charge an administrative fee to cancel the trust and release title when a foreign owner sells.
seller_cost.attorney_helper: Sellers may retain an independent lawyer or advisor to review contracts and negotiate clauses.
seller_cost.disclaimer: Actual taxes are determined by your Notary Public and SAT. Keep facturas and consult professionals for precise calculations.

calculators_page.title: Real Estate Calculators
calculators_page.subtitle: Quickly estimate the costs involved in buying, owning, and selling property in Mexico.
calculators_page.closing_cost_description: Buying? Estimate ISAI transfer tax, notary fees, registration, and other closing costs before you wire funds.
calculators_page.ownership_cost_description: Already own? Project annual holding costs: predial, HOA dues, insurance, maintenance, and management fees.
calculators_page.seller_cost_description: Selling? Model capital gains ISR, agent commission + IVA, legal fees, and fideicomiso cancellation costs.
